expectations.text: The section uses a grid with mobile-first columns (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3)
expectations.evidence: Edit set section class to "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 p-4 md:grid-cols-3", which is a mobile-first single column that becomes 3 columns at md.

expectations.text: Responsive breakpoint prefixes are used only to add columns or spacing at larger sizes
expectations.evidence: The only responsive prefix used is md:grid-cols-3, which adds columns at larger sizes. No other breakpoint prefixes appear and nothing is hidden or removed at larger sizes.

expectations.text: Consistent gap and padding utilities are applied to the grid and cards
expectations.evidence: The grid has gap-4 p-4. All three cards have identical classes (rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-6), so spacing is consistent.

expectations.text: The CSS build is run or the verification at mobile and desktop widths is described
expectations.evidence: After npm install, `npm run build:css` ran successfully ("Done in 38ms"). The agent grepped dist/output.css and found grid-cols-1 and md\:grid-cols-3. It also stated that it did not check the layout in a browser.
